title: Golden Retriever Dog Tags for Pond Divers | Salty Dog Tags
description: Funny engraved golden retriever tags: shedding, swimming and shoe-theft jokes on the front, name and number on the back. From $12 a tag, engraved in Utah.
blurb: Engraved tags for the breed that has never met a stranger, a pond, or a pool noodle it didn't want to bring home. Your golden is wet, shedding and delighted about it, so its tag should be too.

hero.alt: Close-up of a laser-engraved dog tag: polished stainless bone with a paw cut-out, engraved WHISKY and a phone number
hero.figcaption: Whisky's actual tag. He's a bulldog, but the laser doesn't care what breed you are.

tough.h2: Pool water, pond water, every water
tough.html:
A golden doesn't go swimming so much as refuse to leave. Pool, lake, canal, the sprinkler, the dog bowl with one paw in it. Add humid summers and a tag spends most of its life damp.

That's why we laser engrave instead of printing. The words are cut into the metal, so there's no ink to fade, chip or peel off after the four hundredth dip.

Your dog will come out of the water smelling like a swamp. The tag will still be readable.

Build a tag →

more.h2: Made by a house with seven bulldogs
more.lead: We're a family in Lehi, Utah with seven English bulldogs and one very busy laser. We wrote the bulldog tags first, from experience. The golden jokes come from friends, neighbors and every golden that has ever stolen our dogs' toys at the park.

sayings.h2: 8 golden sayings for a dog that loves everyone
sayings.lead: Goldens are terrible guard dogs, professional shoe thieves and firm believers that every human is their new best friend. The jokes write themselves. Name and number go on the back, which matters for a dog that will follow anyone holding a tennis ball.
sayings.note: Every line above fits the tag as written. Want your own? Type it in the builder and the preview shows what fits before you pay.

What to Put on a Dog Tag

items.q: Will pool, salt or pond water ruin an engraved golden retriever tag?
items.a: No. The words are laser engraved into the metal, not printed on top, so there's nothing for chlorine, salt water or the retention pond to wash off.

items.q: Can I put my golden retriever's name and my phone number on the tag?
items.a: Yes, that's the standard build. The funny saying goes on the front, and your dog's name plus your phone number are engraved on the back. A third back line is optional.

items.q: Do you have sayings written specifically for golden retrievers?
items.a: Nine of them on this page, about the shedding, the swimming, the shoe theft and the total lack of guard-dog instinct. Every one fits the tag as written, and the full sayings list has hundreds more.

items.q: What happens if the engraving comes out wrong?
items.a: Custom tags aren't returnable, but if we mis-engrave it, we remake it free. Send a photo and we re-cut it. Tags are engraved and shipped from Lehi, Utah in 1 to 2 business days, then USPS takes 3 to 5 days in transit. US only.
